x.hook: Borrowing USDC against XLM on Soroban works differently under isolated credit execution.
x.copy:
Borrowing USDC against XLM on Soroban works differently under isolated credit execution. Instead of pooled vault insolvency risks, Vanna routes pool liquidity directly through dedicated SmartAccounts.

When you supply assets, LendingPools mint vTokens that track variable rate interest per ledger close. Borrowers pull capital into sandboxed accounts, locked to a strict 1.10x Health Factor floor. At 0.00014 XLM fixed gas and ~320ms Mercury indexer latency, you can loop or route borrowed liquidity straight into Soroban AMMs.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

linkedin.hook: Credit efficiency on Stellar requires separating capital custody from execution risk.
linkedin.copy:
Most money markets treat cross-margin lending as a monolithic risk engine. When an oracle desyncs or a bad debt event hits an asset, the entire pool absorbs the loss. Vanna approaches Soroban credit through isolated execution. LendingPools for native XLM and Circle USDC function purely as capital routing engines, deploying liquidity into sandboxed SmartAccounts rather than commingling collateral in a single shared contract state.

When liquidity providers deposit into the USDC or XLM pools, they receive vTokens that rebase per ledger close to reflect continuous interest accrual. The critical difference lies on the borrowing side. Capital remains bound within deterministic Soroban environments running at 0.00014 XLM fixed gas. Risk engine checks query RedStone feeds with ~320ms Mercury indexer latency, enforcing an invariant 1.10x Health Factor floor before any cross-contract swap or farm execution can settle.

This architecture separates passive yield generation from active execution strategies. LPs earn borrow rates without taking on the smart contract vulnerability of external protocols where borrowed capital gets deployed. Institutional liquidity can now supply baseline assets knowing execution failure risk stays strictly isolated to the individual borrower account. You can deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

reddit.hook: Deep dive into Vanna's XLM/USDC LendingPools: How vTokens and isolated SmartAccounts work on Soroban
reddit.copy:
We have been testing the core credit mechanics for Vanna on Soroban testnet, specifically focusing on the XLM and USDC LendingPool implementation.

### The Capital Layer: LendingPools and vTokens

The base protocol holds capital inside separate LendingPool contracts for XLM and USDC. Supplying capital mints vTokens directly to your wallet. These tokens track variable borrow interest deterministically per ledger close. Rather than calculating interest through chunky cron triggers, the index updates dynamically based on pool utilization every time an interaction occurs.

When borrowers take debt, capital does not exit into an arbitrary external wallet where the protocol loses visibility. It routes into an isolated SmartAccount owned by the borrower.

### The Execution Layer: Sandboxed SmartAccounts

Traditional EVM lending pools require liquidators to seize entire positions because capital leaves the protocol perimeter upon borrowing. Vanna keeps the borrowed capital inside the SmartAccount boundary. 

Borrowers can run composable operations, such as routing borrowed USDC into an AMM liquidity pool or swapping into XLM to loop leverage. Every state change is validated against our risk module. The transaction reverts if the terminal state breaches the 1.10x Health Factor floor.

Oracle verification relies on RedStone pricing feeds monitored with ~320ms Mercury indexer latency. Because Soroban operations execute at roughly 0.00014 XLM fixed gas, complex multi-hop routing and Health Factor verification execute within standard transaction budgets.

### Testing It Out

If you want to poke at the contracts, monitor liquidation thresholds, and deploy test routing strategies, our testnet environment is open. You will need a Freighter wallet pointed to Stellar Testnet with funded test XLM and USDC.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

Disclosure: I am a core contributor at Vanna Protocol working on Soroban credit infrastructure.
